desc: Validate the bounded-hop (<=3 edges) optimal-path hypothesis using brute-force shortest paths on random small interval sets.
Prove the structural lemma and derive the exact candidate-path formula for overlapping endpoints: direct edge, one common neighbor, and two-intermediate paths with compatibility constraints.
Precompute the necessary range/dominance minima for the chosen formula.
Implement the query logic with strict disjointness conditions and endpoint weights counted exactly once.
Verify the implementation against the public samples.
